resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says 20 miles southeast of Kooskia; the Forest Service list says 22 miles SE. No source checked settles it, so the story gives both.

sources.title: West Fork Point Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Elevation is 6,056 ft (about 1,846 m) in sources 1 and 2; elevation_m is still null in the record and elevation is not a facts key, so it was not written here. Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so nothing is stated. Access level is not stated by any source; only the drive-up tag is given. Record kind 'tower' and status 'gone' are consistent with the sources. The distance from Kooskia is the only disagreement found.
